desk_read: Across asset classes, speculative positioning shows broad risk-reduction and selective crowding as prices faced downward pressure over the report week. In energy, Natural Gas highlights a crowded short with a COT index of 4 where the net position moved toward long for 2 consecutive weeks amid a -2.7% futures price drop. Equity index futures show a notable divergence in the S&P 500, where leveraged funds are extended long with a COT index of 86 and added net length for 3 consecutive weeks despite a -2.5% futures price decline, leaving that market fragile. Meanwhile, US 10Y T-Note positioning shows a crowded short with a COT index of 4 after moving toward short for 4 consecutive weeks, alongside an extended short in the Euro where the COT index sits at 1.

Brent managed money net long is +4.5k contracts, down -219 on the week (less long) and up +1.6k over 4 weeks (more long), with a COT index of 44.
